name: ChosenInlineResult

fields.name: result_id
fields.description: The unique identifier for the result that was chosen

fields.name: from
fields.description: The user that chose the result

fields.name: location
fields.description: Sender location, only for bots that enabled user location requests via @BotFather or using the parameter needs_inline_query_location of the method setMySettings

fields.name: inline_message_id
fields.description: Identifier of the sent inline message. Available only if there is an inline keyboard attached to the message. Will be also received in callback queries and can be used to edit the message.

fields.name: query
fields.description: The query that was used to obtain the result

description: Represents a result of an inline query that was chosen by the user and sent to their chat partner. Note: It is necessary to enable inline feedback via @BotFather or using the parameter inline_feedback_share_denominator of the method setMySettings in order to receive these objects in updates.
